mathematics.assertion_tested: Enumerate exact primitive coefficient squareclass lanes for a^3*u^6+b^5*v^10=c^7*w^14; verify dyadic coefficient projection and quantify loss under separate marginals.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact integer arithmetic in Z/mZ and F_p; no floating arithmetic in residue computations
mathematics.conventions: Primitive local means at most one base a*u^2,b*v^2,c*w^2 divisible by p. Coefficients have p-valuation zero or one and at most one coefficient is divisible by p.

bounds.odd_coefficient_classes: all 20 triples of labels 0,S,N with at most one 0, at each prime
bounds.dyadic_coefficients: all coefficient residue triples with every coefficient not divisible by 4, and at most one even coefficient
bounds.independent_check: all coefficient residues modulo 3,5,7 with at most one zero, all four primitive phases; compare lookup method with literal root-triple enumeration

non_claims: Does not prove nonexistence of integer solutions for surviving coefficient families.
Does not prove an exhaustive list of useful primes beyond 101.
The universal p-adic saturation statement is proved separately in notes/stratification.md and is not inferred from finite testing.
